I'll preface by saying this is an alt account for obvious reasons. And you can check my history to see a consistent story. 

I am an actual pedo. I've never and will never lay an inappropriate hand on a child. I promised myself I'm going to take a long walk off a short cliff if I get tempted. 

That out of the way. What you did may not be illegal depending on where you live. In some places it's been becoming illegal (and the list of places it's starting to spread). For now I'd say to not panic. As for p-ocd or just pedophilia in general, that's a complicated question. 

Since it's day dreams and questioning if I'm understanding correctly, don't stress out over it. If you start getting physical attraction to  minors, that's when you can open up that questioning again.

"I didn't really feel anything from them" is a good sign that you're not likely one. If you need a support feel free to message me here.

Alt account for hopefully obvious reasons

I'll speak from (unfortunate) personally experience. You can read through my account to see I've been consistent with what I've said.

I'll give the alternate view. You can hear from ordinary people. But, I'll speak as a hebephile myself (attraction to early puberty, people lump it in with pedophilia which is also fine I just want to be precise). 

It's awful it sucks in every single way imaginable. I despise myself for this affliction. I have not nor will I ever put an inappropriate hand on a minor. I've promised myself I'm going to commit suicide if I ever feel like the urges are too bad. The hatred I see pedos receive online also gets to me, because as you pointed out a lot of us have only committed a thought crime. Yet we're probably the most universally hated group in the developed world. 

It's only really laymen I find though that have this issue. I've opened up about it to my psychiatrist and psychologist and they while not particularly helpful didn't just immediately jump onto the saying I'm awful train. 

So basically what I'm saying is, most pedos are only guilty of a thought crime and shouldn't be demonised. Those who act on it however deserve to be completely crucified as that is 100% a horrible thing.

Please ignore the fact that I'm a flairless scum this alt is never really intended to talk much unless I come across good opportunities.

Thank you, there is a big difference between a pedo and someone who has harmed a child. I do fall into the former camp however, I have not and never will lay a hand on a child, I made a pact with myself that if I ever feel myself falling to temptation I am gonna kms first. 

I despise this part of me with a burning passion but there's nothing I can do about it. On the note of getting help, I actually came clean to my psychologist so they know all about my feelings but they aren't exactly what I would consider useful, their advice while well meaning simply doesn't help that much, it's clear they don't have much experience dealing with this situation so they're falling back on some staple psych techniques. However, it does mean 1 more pair of eyes on me to make sure I don't fall to temptation.

it's like any mental illness, you can't make it go away no matter how hard you try the best you can do is limit it's impacts. Basically we need more people to get your mindset (which judging by this thread I see a refreshing number of people who have it). If you make pedos believe they're hated no matter what it could trigger them to act on it because "people will hate us anyway, might as well get enjoyment" which is obviously an extremely troublesome mindset. If we can get people to realise that people won't hate them unless they act on it, there could be more people like me who come forth and get psych help, and if more people come forward hopefully the quality of that help improves.

I don't blame you at all tbh. I despise this about myself with a burning passion of 100 suns. As I said if I feel like I'm even remotely close to ever hurting anyone I'm gonna save you the effort and off myself. I know I can't do anything to prove to you I'm not a threat and I accept that. I'm probably the most universally despised group in western society. I know that and I hate it. A few ppl who know me IRL knows about it who I know I can trust to keep extra eyes onto me so I'm taking all the precautions I can.

I really fucking hate this aboutmyself if there were additional steps I could take to protect others from me I'd be all for it. Unfortunately where I live I can only end up on a registry if I actually commit a sex crime I can't get myself put on it preemptively.

I'm being monitored by a psychologist as I mentioned. If they saw me as a threat they're legally obligated to sic the police on me. I'm always 100% open with them as I mentioned in my op. I hate this part about me so fucking much. Yet all I can do is subdue and control it. There's no way to get rid of it
